defs.def: either of the two parts of the body between the top of each arm and the neck 肩；肩膀；肩胛

ex.s: B．To stress the need of shouldering responsibilities at work．
ex.t: B．明智的人可以不自怨自艾地生活。

ex.s: The girl is looking over her shoulder.
Realising that something 3____ (move) on my shoulder, I turn my head to look at it.
ex.t: 意识到有什么东西在我肩上3____（动），我转过头去看。

ex.s: Michelangelo’s David is before the battle, looking ahead in confidence, with his sling across his shoulder.
ex.t: 米开朗基罗的大卫像是在战斗之前，满怀信心地凝视前方，投石器搭在肩上。

ex.s: Sherry Wilson lost her right arm just below the shoulder.
ex.t: 雪莉·威尔逊失去了右臂，伤口就在肩膀下方。

defs.def: having the type of shoulders mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: Mr Dena kept an unforgettable ___41___ by Sir Isaac Newton on his chalk board: “If I have been able to see further, it is only because I stand on the shoulders of giants.” He reflected on that throughout the year and was ___42___ to teach us more than math.
Harry threw the cloak around his shoulders… Harry looked down at his feet, but they were gone.
ex.t: 哈利把斗篷披在肩上……哈利低头看自己的脚，但它们不见了。

defs.def: the part of a piece of clothing that covers the shoulder （衣服的）肩部

ex.s: The boy lifted the last bag onto his shoulder, and flashed a bright smile.
A lunchtime escape allows her to keep a boss from tapping her on the shoulder.
ex.t: 午餐时间的逃离让她可以避免老板拍肩膀叫她。

defs.def: meat from the top part of one of the front legs of an animal that has four legs 前腿连肩肉
a part of sth, such as a bottle or mountain, that is shaped like a shoulder 山肩；瓶肩
an area of ground at the side of a road where vehicles can stop in an emergency 路肩（公路两侧供车辆紧急停靠的地带）
physically close to sb 肩并肩地；紧挨着
as one group that has the same aims, opinions, etc. 并肩；齐心协力
to accept the responsibility for sth 承担；担负
to push forward with your shoulder in order to get somewhere 挤；闯
to push sb/sth out of your way with your shoulder （用肩膀）推开，顶开
to carry sth on your shoulder 背；扛；挑；担
